input.command:
python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0039.png')
# Let's inspect row 350
row350 = img[350]
# find white pixels on row 350
white_cols = np.where((row350[:, 0] > 230) & (row350[:, 1] > 230) & (row350[:, 2] > 230))[0]
print('White cols at row 350:', white_cols.min(), white_cols.max())

# Find the full bounding box of the white box at row 350
# Let's find all rows where col in [white_cols.min(), white_cols.max()] is white
col_mid = (white_cols.min() + white_cols.max()) // 2
white_rows = np.where((img[:, col_mid, 0] > 230) & (img[:, col_mid, 1] > 230) & (img[:, col_mid, 2] > 230))[0]
print(f'White panel at col {col_mid}: row [{white_rows.min()}, {white_rows.max()}]')
"
